help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:479  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:480
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:481  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:482  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:485    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:486    is the only thing that catches it.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:673  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:674
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:675  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:676  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:677  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:678  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:679  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:683  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:685  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:686  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:689  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:692  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698  Existing destination to compute the difference set against,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:699  repeatable. Default: every other destination in the config.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:702  Repository path override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:705  Masterkey file override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:708  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:711  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:714  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:717  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:718  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:719  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:720  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:724  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:725
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:726  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:727  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:728  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:729  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:730  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:731  In a separate metadata-only run, use `--cost` to estimate the payload
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:732  size before choosing a full-text mode. `--scan` reads those payloads;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:733  `--text` uses the local index and checks that it covers the selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:734  sessions before treating zero hits as a complete answer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:735
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:736  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:737  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:738
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:739  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:740  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:741  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:742  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:743  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:745
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:746  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:747  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:748  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:749  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:750  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:751
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:752  `--surface` filters on the **observed** surface dimension (ADR-059):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:753  a session matches only if its records name the value — claude-code's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:754  Cowork transcripts record `desktop-cowork` — and a session whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:755  records carry no surface at all (the CLI library records none: an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:756  absent observation is never read as an implicit `cli`) is listed as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:757  unplaceable while the filter is active. The value must be one the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:758  registry declares in its `dimensions.surfaces` (`cli`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:759  `desktop-cowork`, …); anything else is a usage error, because a typo
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:760  named as a filter must not come back as an empty result. With the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:761  flag absent every surface is in scope and the search behaves exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:762  as it did before the dimension existed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:763
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764  `--text` searches the local FTS5 trigram index (substring matching for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:765  runs of at least three characters). A shorter query is refused, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:766  answered: the report says `matched=unknown` and the run exits `3`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  `--scan` reads selected conversations and matches them as plain text
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:768  instead; it answers short queries, at the cost of reading them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:769
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:770  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:771  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:772  destination and answered for every session with no match, `3` could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:773  finish — reading it, placing every session in time, or evaluating the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  query — so a zero proves nothing. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:776  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:779  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / surface / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:782  Search indexed titles and user/assistant text with SQLite's trigram tokenizer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:785  Read selected sessions and perform a case-insensitive substring scan.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:788  Emit one JSON object on stdout. Metadata searches include separate
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:789  matched / not matched / could-not-be-placed groups; text searches
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:790  carry coverage, read failures and a `query_state` for the query.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:793  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:796  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:799  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:802  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:805  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:808  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:812  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:813
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:814  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:818  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:819
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:821  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:822  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:824  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:825  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:826  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:827  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:829  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:830  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:832  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:833  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:835  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:836  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:837  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:838
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:839  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:841
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:842  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:844  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:845  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:846  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:847  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:849  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:852  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:855  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / surface / time window),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:856  resolved by the same code as `search` — a `--surface` value the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:857  registry does not declare is refused here too.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:860  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:861  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:862  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  ADR-061: also emit the records the source deleted, at their
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  original positions, each carrying `"deleted": true`. The default
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:873  view stays the source's final state; this switch is how the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:874  deleted history — still stored, never erased — becomes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  reachable. Snapshot-source sessions (opencode) only; other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:876  harnesses ignore the switch (their bodies are growth logs).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:879  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:880  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:883  Write every stored shard. By default a run that byte-for-byte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  replays the session's complete preceding shard sequence is collapsed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:885  to its first copy, because that is what a re-seal leaves. The archive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:886  is never modified either way.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:889  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:890  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:893  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:896  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:905  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:910  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:924
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:925  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:926  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. The only
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:927  conversation text that read carries is each session's one-line label
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:928  (at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index); a session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:929  full conversation is fetched and decrypted only when you click it and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:930  then click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  codes: 0 served the dashboard — even an archive that holds nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:932  which is served as an honest empty page rather than not starting; 3
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:933  could not finish reading (or no key), and is also the exit status after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:934  serving an archive that could not be read in full; 2 is a usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:936  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:937  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:939  Backfill the audit sidecar from historical sealed bodies without rewriting them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:941  Stage receiving the derived sidecar; source bodies remain untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  Partition owned by this writer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:947  Retained archive-wide random secret (exactly 32 bytes), outside stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950  Scan only the stage, explicitly excluding historical destination bodies.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:960  Import an official export — or one harness's local-cache backup.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:961
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:962  Two modes share this command.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:963
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:964  **Takeout mode** (with a `<platform>` and `<export>`): archive the file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965  byte-exact, and — where the platform's conversation import is open in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:966  this build — write one inbox bundle per conversation into a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:967  inbox. Claude's run reads `<export>` whole, stores it under
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  `<stage>/import-raw/<platform>/<sha256>` — a sibling of `sessions/`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:969  so it is in no session count — and writes one `chat-stasher/inbox@3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:970  `web-capture` bundle per conversation into `--inbox`, for a later
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:971  `ingest --inbox` to seal. This mode never seals, never pushes, never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:972  reads the config or a destination, and never modifies or moves the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:973  export file.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:974
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:975  Grok's run is held by this build's development import gate at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:976  **raw-export archiving only**: the export is parsed and sealed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:977  byte-exact as its own object under
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:978  `<stage>/export-files/<platform>/<sha256>/<name>`, its index row
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:979  files under `meta/<machine>/`, and **no conversation bundle is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:980  written** — the refused half is what the run says in its output.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:981  `--machine` names the partition that index row belongs to and is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:982  required for such a platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:983
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:984  Claude's `conversations.json` and Grok's `prod-grok-backend.json`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:985  have parsers in this build; naming any other platform is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:986  refusal, not a guess.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:987
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:988  **Backup-restore mode** (`--harness grok-bot --from <dir>`): feed a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:989  copied Grok Bot cache — one backup directory, several, overlapping
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:990  ones, whatever was copied aside — into the archive once, as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:991  first-class pass instead of a `[harness_roots]` workaround. Each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:992  session found in the backup is delivered through its own delivered-set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:993  identity (machine + agent uuid), so only rows that session has never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:994  archived are sealed: a backup that overlaps the live cache or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:995  earlier import adds exactly its new rows, once. Re-running the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:996  import delivers nothing. The backup is only ever read; the live cache
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:997  is never touched, and the ordinary collect after an import still
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:998  delivers only what is genuinely new. Each sealed shard's `_chat_stasher`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:999  line records that it came from a backup import, the backup directory's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1000  basename and the import time. `--dry-run` reports the per-session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1001  counts and writes nothing anywhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1002
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1003  Exit codes (both modes): `0` = everything was read to the end and

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1163  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1167  — and, fail-safe, a destination whose push record is unreadable —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1168  must prove; a destination whose last successful push is older than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1169  its degrade-after, or with no push on record, is degraded: not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1170  consulted for proof, listed and alarmed on every run with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1171  two-road advice (repair the push, or remove the destination from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1172  config). The command then retires the shard body once every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1173  must-prove destination proves it holds each session. Proof means
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1174  asking the archive itself — never the local cursor — for the digest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1175  triple (shard count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1176  matching it against the stage. A must-prove destination that cannot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1177  be consulted is "unproven" and blocks: it is never treated as "does
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1178  not have it". If no destination can prove at all, nothing is deleted
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1179  either — the ≥1 guard.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1180
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1181  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1182  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1183  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1184  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1185  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1220  A mirror is a byte-exact, file-by-file copy of one declared remote
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1221  destination's whole repository, on local disk under the data
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1222  directory, ciphertext only: `config`, `keys/`, `index/`, `snapshots/`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1223  and `data/` — everything except `locks/`, which this build never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1224  holds. Copying a repo also copies its encrypted master key, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1225  the same key the destination already uses, not a new one, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1226  copy never decrypts anything: every file except `config` is verified
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1227  by hashing the bytes against the file's own name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1228
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1229  One run is one round (W964's discipline): it lists the remote,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1230  downloads what the mirror lacks, and stops where the round's budget
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1231  `--budget-secs` (default 600) says, leaving the next round to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1232  resume from the same listing-diff — progress is recorded every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1233  round, and a stopped round is reported, never counted as a failure.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1234  The hourly pass runs the same copy after its push, inside that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1235  round's leftover budget.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1236
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1237  Before a first fill starts it estimates whether the remaining
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1238  download plus the free-disk floor (`[mirror] min_free_gib`, default
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1239  max(10 GiB, 5% of the volume's capacity)) fits the free space, and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1240  refuses with both numbers when it does not. Mid-round, free space
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1241  falling below the floor pauses the copy instead of writing toward a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1242  full disk.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1243
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1244  Exit codes: 0 = the mirror holds everything the remote listed;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1245  3 = the round stopped or refused and made no progress it did not

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1247  pre-estimate refused — the next round resumes); 1 = a finished

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1261  is no mode in this build that deletes.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1262
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1263  Dry run is the only mode. `--apply` is refused with exit `3`, naming
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1264  what a safe delete would need and this build does not have: a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1265  repository-wide lock every client honors, a conditional delete carrying
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1266  an object version, and a trustworthy backend modification time to age
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1267  candidates by. "Unindexed" means no index file names the pack, not that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1268  the pack is unused — a retry can reuse one and write a snapshot that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1269  depends on it while it stays unindexed on disk — so the gap is real, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1270  a formality.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1271
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1272  Every pack it reports gets the shared interrupted-push
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1273  classification: bytes that verify complete are **stranded** — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1274  next open adopts them; bytes that cannot be read as a pack at all
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1275  are **torn debris** from an interrupted push, which belongs to no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1276  backup and can be ignored. Anything else is **unknown**, with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1277  verifier's reason — the one state that makes the survey incomplete.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1278
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1279  Reads only: nothing is written to the repository, to an index file or to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1280  a pack. The report carries the repository fingerprint, the backend family,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1281  pack and byte totals, the unindexed packs by id prefix and size, what the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1282  next push would adopt, and any pack an index names that the backend does
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1283  not list — and never a path, host, machine, account or conversation text.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1284
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1285  Exit codes: 0 = the survey read every pack, torn debris included — it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1286  is a known state, not an unfinished read; 1 = it read everything and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1287  found an index naming a pack the backend does not list; 3 = it did
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1288  not finish reading — a pack or an index file could not be read, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1289  backend was unreachable, or `--apply` was asked for — no absence in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1290  the output proves anything; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1292  Named destination from the config. Required unless `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1295  Check the destination and stop: no repository is opened and nothing

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1299  Refused. Present so that asking to delete gets an answer that names
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1300  what a safe delete would need, rather than an unknown-flag error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1303  Print exactly one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1324  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1325  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1326
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1327  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1328  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1329  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1330  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1331
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1332  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1333  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1334  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1335  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1336  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1337  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1338
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1339  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1340  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1341
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1342  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1343  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1344  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1345  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1346  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1348  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1349  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1350  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1353  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1354  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1355  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1358  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1361  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1362  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1363  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1366  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1369  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1372  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1375  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1378  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1381  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1382  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1383  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1384  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1385  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1386  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1390  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1391
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1392  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1393  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1394  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1395  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1396  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1397
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1398  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1399  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1400  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1401  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1402  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1403
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1404  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1405  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1406  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1408  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1412  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1413
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1414  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1415  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1416  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1417  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1418  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1419  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1420
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1421  With `--rebuild --destination`, the index is rebuilt from the archive,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1422  which is all a machine whose stage is gone still needs: no source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1423  machine, and no copy of its stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1424
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1425  What that rebuild does depends on which partition is named and on
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1426  whether there is a stage to restore into, because a partition's index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1427  written by the machine that owns it (ADR-017):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1428
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1429  * **This machine's own partition, with a `--stage` directory** — every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1430    archived session is restored to a temporary child of it, the full
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1431    index is rebuilt and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1432    snapshots stay immutable; nothing is pushed until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1433    restore finish. A same-machine snapshot found before publication
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1434    restarts the rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1435  * **Any other machine, or any machine when there is no stage directory
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1436    to restore into** — the rebuild is **read-only**. That machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1437    archived sessions are read cumulatively across its snapshots and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1438    rows are written to a derived index in this machine's cache (the path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1439    is printed). The destination is not modified at all: no snapshot is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1440    appended and no path in the named machine's partition is written,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1441    because no record authorizes one machine to rewrite another's.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1442
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1443  Both modes are safe to re-run, and neither is resumable: each run starts
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1444  over. A read-only run needs the destination and the masterkey, and no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1445  `--stage` at all — which is how a machine whose stage is gone, this one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1446  included, still derives its index from the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1447
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1448  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1449  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1450  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1451  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1452  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1453
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1454  Metadata, with one declared exception: the extraction keeps a timestamp
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1455  per line and throws the line away, and — for claude-code sessions —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1456  additionally keeps the capped one-line label the dashboard lists the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1457  session under (the harness's own title, or the head of the session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1458  first user line; see the `ui` labels). That label — at most 100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1459  characters, with its provenance — is the one piece of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1460  conversation-derived text the metadata tier ever holds. Nothing else is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1461  ever kept, and the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1462
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1463  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1464  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1465  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1466  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1467  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1468  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1470  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1471  destination rebuild of **this** machine's own partition (temporary
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1472  restored shards are removed after the new snapshot is written).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1473  Omitted, or not a directory, the rebuild restores nothing and is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1474  read-only for any machine, this one included.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1477  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1478  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1479  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1482  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. Repair workflows
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1483  and investigation want the predictable hammer — every session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1484  re-derived from its bytes, whatever the previous index says — and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1485  this spelling makes that intent visible. Required for destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1486  (`--destination`/`--repo`) rebuilds. A local `--stage` build
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1487  defaults to this and only this unless `--incremental` is passed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1490  Update the index incrementally instead of rebuilding it: sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1491  whose bodies and inputs provably did not change since the last
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1492  build keep their measured row; everything else is re-derived as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1493  full rebuild would. Local `--stage` builds only; the result must
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1494  stay byte-identical to a full rebuild. `run-once` uses this path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1495  for its pre-push index build.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1498  Destination to rebuild from. Requires `--rebuild`; either this or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1499  `--repo` must be named. Appends the repaired snapshot when the named
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1500  `--machine` is this machine's own partition and `--stage` is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1501  directory; otherwise the rebuild is read-only and the result goes to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1502  a derived local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1505  Repository path override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1508  Masterkey file override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1511  Concurrency cap override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1514  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1517  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1521  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1522
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1523  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1524  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1525  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1526  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1527  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1528
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1529  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1530  the system's LocalHostName (`scutil --get LocalHostName` on macOS,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1531  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1532  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1533
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1534  Exit codes: `0` = the declaration was written; `3` = the machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1535  partition could not be resolved or the identity is unusable; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1536  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1538  Stage directory to write the declaration into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1541  Human display name for this machine. Default: system LocalHostName.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1545  Give a dead or sold machine a display name (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1546
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1547  Writes `<stage>/meta/<target>/label-by-<local-identity>.json` — a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1548  `LabelRecord` expressing *this* machine's opinion about what `<target>`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1549  should be called. It exists for machines that can no longer declare for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1550  themselves (sold, dead, in a different building). Each file has exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1551  one writer, so concurrent machines never fight over it; the overview
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1552  shows the label with the latest `written_at_unix`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1553
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1554  Exit codes: `0` = the label was written; `3` = the local identity could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1555  not be resolved; `1` = the file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1557  Stage directory to write the label into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1560  Machine id (partition) being labelled, e.g. a 32-hex identity.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1563  Display-name override for the target.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1567  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1568  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1569
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1570  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1571  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1572  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1573  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1574  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1575  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1576  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1577  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1578  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1579  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1580
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1581  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1582  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1583  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1584
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1585  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1586  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1587  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1588  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1589  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1591  Destination to open. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1592  there is no default destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1595  Terminal width for the matrix/heatmap (default: 100).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1598  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1599  human matrix/heatmap is suppressed). Per-session `first_unix` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1600  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1601  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1602  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1603  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1604  reason in `error`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1607  With `--json`, emit the aggregate summary variant instead of the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1608  full document: totals, one record per machine and per source, and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1609  the last 30 local days' counts, with no per-session array. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1610  variant is named `"summary"` in the object.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1613  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1616  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1619  Concurrency cap override.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1625  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1629  Manage this machine's body cache (ADR-034).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1630
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1631  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1632  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1633  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1634  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1635  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1636  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1638  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1642  Build or inspect the per-destination local full-text index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1647  Backfill an opt-in source's older history through its own app
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1648  (ADR-058 D1). Only Grok Bot exists today.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1649
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1650  The Grok Bot local cache is a bounded window, and every position
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1651  that fell out of it is gone from disk for good — but the server
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1652  still holds the conversation, and whenever the app opens one, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1653  app itself fetches the conversation's whole user-visible span into
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1654  view. `backfill grok-bot` relaunches the app with a debugging
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1655  connection that listens only on this machine, opens one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1656  conversation at a time exactly as a person clicking the sidebar
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1657  would, waits while the app loads it, and delivers the rows the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1658  archive does not already hold — marked as backfilled, through the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1659  same session identity a collect uses, so nothing is added twice and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1660  an ordinary collect after a backfill stays incremental.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1661
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1662  **The default is a dry run**: with no extra flags the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1663  read-only traversal runs — it too relaunches and drives the app —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1664  and it only reports (per conversation: rows it would add, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1665  loaded span versus the locally held span, and the positions that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1666  will stay missing). Rows are delivered only with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1667  `--i-accept-the-risk`, which is what the public doc names, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1668  risk statement is printed before every run, a dry run included.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1669
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1670  The run is user-started only: no schedule, daemon or config path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1671  can reach it. The app is restored to a normal launch at the end of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1672  every run — including Ctrl-C, where what has been delivered stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1673  delivered. The interior positions the vendor's service never sends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1674  the app stay missing and the session's gap record and `partial`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1675  fidelity stand: the archive never claims completeness.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1676
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1677  Exit codes: `0` every selected conversation loaded and was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1678  reported (or delivered) · `1` the traversal finished with findings
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1679  — a conversation that never finished loading within its wait and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1680  was skipped whole, a `--conversation` prefix that matched nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1681  a restore that could not be verified — or the app could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1682  restored to a normal launch · `2` usage (including a `--stage`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1683  that is not a directory) · `3` the run refused (macOS only, app
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1684  not installed, a signed-in app unconfirmable, the debug endpoint
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1685  unusable) or stopped before finishing — a user interrupt or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1686  app-layout change; partial work is kept and reported.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1688  The harness whose app-driven backfill this runs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1689  Only `grok-bot` exists today.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1692  Existing stage directory receiving the sealed shards. Never

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1728  The state is a durable control record appended to this machine's

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1730  ordinary `push` archives it with the stage, and every machine honors
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1731  it from the destination's control stream. The identity is exact: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1732  session id as named, in one machine partition — a session with the

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1794  Purge one named session from selected destinations — a dry-run
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1795  preview only (W402 interaction design). It reads every selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1796  destination and reports, per destination, whether the exact named

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1801  nothing: no archive, stage, destination or index is changed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1802
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1803  **The default is the dry run, and this build has no other mode.**
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1804  The destructive purge — the exclusive maintenance gate, the tombstone

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1810
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1811  The identity is exact: the session id as named, in one machine

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1813  in other partitions are not the target. Destinations are explicit:

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2038  The parameters of the remote step, exactly as the caller supplied them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2039
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2040  Every field here is either a name or a location. **No field can carry a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2041  secret**, and that is the point of the shape rather than an accident of it:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2042  the two credential fields are the *names of environment variables*, which the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2043  wizard writes into the config as `env:NAME` and never resolves itself. So a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2044  secret cannot reach the config file as plaintext, and it cannot reach
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2045  `argv` — where it would be captured by the process list and by any log that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2046  echoes the command — because there is no flag that would accept one.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2049  Which recipe to write.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2052  SFTP: `ssh://<host>:<port>`. S3: the service endpoint, e.g.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2053  `https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2056  SFTP only: the ssh user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2059  SFTP only: the private key to authenticate with. Optional — leaving it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2060  out lets the backend use the ssh agent and its own default keys, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2061  a real configuration rather than a gap.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2064  S3 only: the bucket (or container) the repository lives in.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2067  S3 only: the region. R2 is single-region and names it `auto`; another
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2068  S3-compatible service names its own.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2071  Both kinds: the prefix inside the account/bucket that the repository
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2072  lives under. Optional, and omitted rather than defaulted: a prefix the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2073  user did not choose would put their archive somewhere they did not name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2076  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the access key
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2077  id. Not the key id itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2080  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the secret
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2081  access key. Not the secret.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2084  Declare that this host's key was checked out of band, which authorizes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2085  recording it in `~/.ssh/known_hosts`. A declaration, not a verification:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2086  nothing here, and nothing anywhere else, can check that the comparison

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:349  command's argument struct so the two commands cannot drift apart.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:350
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:351  Conflicts are expressed here rather than re-implemented per command:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:352  mixing a local-day flag with a unix-seconds flag is a usage error
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:353  regardless of which command asked.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:356  Match sessions whose id starts with this prefix.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:359  Match one machine partition exactly.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:362  Match these harnesses, comma-separated (e.g. `--harness claude-code,codex`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:363  The harness is the leading `.`/`~` segment of the archived session id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:366  Match an observed runtime surface (ADR-059): the session's records
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:367  must name this exact value in their `surface` dimension. `cli` and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:368  `desktop-cowork` are the claude-code values; the full vocabulary is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:369  the registry's `dimensions.surfaces` union, validated by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:370  [`Self::resolve_validated`] — an unknown value is a usage error,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:371  never an empty result. A session whose records carry no surface at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:372  all (claude-code's CLI library records none) is listed as unplaceable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:373  while this filter is active: an absent observation is not a value.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:374  `--sub-surface` remains an alias.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:377  One local calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Identical to `--since D --until D`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:384  Earliest local calendar day to include, `YYYY-MM-DD`, from that day's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:385  00:00:00 local time.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:389  23:59:59 local time.
